notes.title: Windose Update & Steam Scream Fest
notes.notes:
『NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD』 will now have Russian localization available, which can be selected from the option menu.

Get ready for our participation in the 'Steam Scream Fest (Halloween Sale)' from October 29th to November 5th! 
For one week only, enjoy a spine-tickling 60% off on Steam. 
Don’t miss out on this limited-time offer!

We hope you continue to enjoy 『NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD』
Bless.

The update will be the implementation of the "Streaming Generator."
This feature allows you to create your own original "OMGkawaiiAngel Stream."
・For instructions, please click here:
　https://drive.google.com/file/d/1i8j0y1wG_Wd9AnpPFofA9CrGsWicSjAQ/view

Thank you for your continous support for NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD!

notes.title: Windose Major title update
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience.

The updates are as follows :
・Several endings added
・Additonal text such as Tweeter replies
・Additional sticker responses from Ame

Please keep supporting NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD!

notes.title: Windose Update v1.0.25
notes.notes:
- Added Traditional Chinese
- Toned down Ame's odd behaviors during the recording event
- Fine-tuned how followers are increased
- Fixed an issue with the game stopping after entering the 31st day in certain conditions
- Adusted conditions for some endings, making 100% completion easier
- Made Korean fonts easier to read
- Fixed numerous other minor bugs

- Fixed an issue with certain endings not being able to be unlocked when playing the game in Korean.

notes.title: Patch note （2022/01/24）
notes.notes:
We have made some performance improvements for the game.
We will continue to improve the game's performance in the future, but for this patch, we have reduced the load since certain Mac machines were having trouble progressing due to the high load rate.
In addition to the above, we have also made other minor adjustments, such as fixing the music to play in MV events.
We hope you will continue to enjoy NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD.

notes.notes: Fixed some endings that were difficult to progress

notes.title: NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE Announcement of Postponement of Release
notes.notes:
We would like to officially announce that in order to focus on providing players with the highest-quality game possible, the release of NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE – originally scheduled for Steam release on June 5th, 2021 – has been postponed.

The final release date will be announced upon confirmation.
We want to offer our sincerest apologies to all of the players who have been waiting patiently for this release, and we appreciate your understanding and support as we further increase our efforts to provide you with the best and most appropriate “play” possible.

NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE Overview

NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE is a “multi-ending ADV” depicting daily life with “OMGkawaiiAngel-chan”, a young girl with a rather extreme need for approval attempting to become the #1 “Internet Angel” (streamer). Gradually build up OMGkawaiiAngel-chan’s number of followers as she spends her days streaming, using various medications, and generally being kinda messed up. Experience all the different crazy ups and downs and find out for yourself whether this story is even capable of having a happy ending.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076964/8ab0c2bdb27a0a8240c2d76175c37949123c3a50.jpg

Enjoy spending your days together with a young girl striving to become the #1 “Internet Angel” (streamer).

Her various activities will increase and decrease her different parameters, which will in turn affect how the story branches out. She also goes out (on dates) and self-medicates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076964/e24a641fca47ed4fc4f466d5b7bda913e17f0bf7.png

Choose the best possible combinations for various elements of her stream (content, style, etc.) to induce “Fever”, possibly even scoring loads of views and followers at once.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076964/9fce971f0dd4e89725b5163c335cf6bd1e515358.png

Use SNS to check up on OMGkawaiiAngel-chan’s (public) account) as well as Amechan’s (private) account to see what she’s been saying.
